envVars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
envVars.description: Anon key (public by design, row-level security applies)

humanSteps: Sign in with `supabase login` (opens the browser), unless the Supabase CLI is already signed in.
Pick a project if the account has more than one and this folder isn't linked.
rotation: Not automatic: roll the keys in the Supabase dashboard, then run `keysmith connect supabase --force`.

humanSteps: Sign in with `neonctl auth` (opens the browser), unless the Neon CLI is already signed in.
Pick a project if the account has more than one.
rotation: Not automatic: reset the role's password in the Neon console, then run `keysmith connect neon --force`.

envVars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
envVars.description: Publishable key exposed to Next.js client code

humanSteps: Approve a pairing code in the browser (Stripe CLI sign-in), unless the Stripe CLI is already signed in.
If the Stripe CLI isn't installed, the user must approve installing it: brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe
rotation: Only for keys from the Stripe CLI: picks up the newer key after `stripe login`. A key pasted from the dashboard must be rolled there, then reconnected with `keysmith connect stripe --tier capture --force`.

envVars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Signing secret for events forwarded by `stripe listen` (test mode)

humanSteps: None if the Stripe CLI is signed in to the same account as the Stripe key. Otherwise the user runs `stripe switch` or `stripe login`.
rotation: Not supported: the secret belongs to the Stripe CLI. After `stripe login` or switching accounts, run `keysmith connect stripe-webhook --force`.

envVars.name: RESEND_API_KEY
envVars.description: Sending-access API key used by the app

humanSteps: Paste one Full access API key (from resend.com/api-keys) into a hidden macOS dialog, unless the Resend CLI is already logged in with one.
rotation: Creates a new sending-only key with the stored full-access key, verifies it, swaps it in, then deletes the old one. Running apps must restart.

humanSteps: Sign in with `gh auth login`, unless the GitHub CLI is already signed in.
Without the GitHub CLI (or with --tier capture): paste a fine-grained token from https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new into a hidden macOS dialog.
rotation: Not automatic: run `gh auth refresh` (CLI token) or regenerate the fine-grained token, then `keysmith connect github --force`.

rotation: Not automatic: create a new project token in the dashboard, run `keysmith connect railway --force`, then delete the old token.
